next_step: POC kickoff with dedicated trial + vector DB integration plan; pricing review with finance
notes:
Prospect profile: mid-market SaaS vendor building a searchable knowledge layer for developer docs and customer support articles. Evaluating Hosted API for early integration, with clear plan to move to Dedicated capacity if POC meets throughput/cost targets.

Key quotes: 'We need search latency to feel instantaneous for devs' — Head of Product. 'If nightly batch can finish in our off-hours window, cost optics look good' — CTO.

Technical summary:
- Primary workload: semantic_search over product docs + embeddings store for recommendations.
- Batch jobs: ~3M existing documents to be embedded over first migration; incremental nightly adds ~35k items. Target: complete initial migration within 10 days or run parallel batch pipelines.
- Throughput targets: search QPS 120-200 sustained (spikes to 400 during product launches), target p95 latency < 120ms (search end-to-end including nearest-neighbor lookup).
- Embedding throughput: want ability to run background embedding jobs at ~50k vectors/hour per cluster; capability to parallelize across nodes.
- Vector DB integration: primary interest in Pinecone & Milvus; they want Redwood to confirm supported TTLs, indexing/replica behavior, and recommendations for chunking and vector dimensionality.
- Models: prefer open/Redwood-verified embedding models (cost-sensitive) but will test a high-quality baseline for relevance. Considering 1536-d and 1024-d variants depending on cost.
- Failure modes: must have graceful fallback to smaller model variant or cached results in region if Dedicated capacity constrained.

POC scope (agreed):
- 2-week hosted demo with synthetic + 100k real-doc subset to validate recall/latency.
- Optional Dedicated 30-day trial (reserved pool) to validate sustained QPS and batch throughput on 4xA10-equivalent nodes.
- Integration checklist: API keys + scoped roles, SSO test account, sample connector to Pinecone (weaviate optional).

Commercial:
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget. Line-of-sight to $75k–$185k ARR for initial contract if Dedicated required. Looking for predictable per-month cost and commit tiers; interested in burst-to-dedicated behavior.

Operational/security:
- Require SOC2-type answers, audit_logging for query history (30d), KMS-managed encryption for customer data, and option to keep vector index in AWS eu-west-1 for EU customers.
- Legal: negotiating data residency clause for EU customers (affects rollout).

Sales notes / personality:
- Fast-moving product org; decision driven by CTO + Head of Product, procurement engaged on budget. Prefers concise technical runbooks and a clear POC success criteria list.
- Communication tone: terse, engineering-first. Provide perf numbers and example notebooks.

Stated blockers: budget signoff, legal data residency clause, final pricing for Dedicated reserved pool.

Attachments / artifacts: pricing deck link (drive), security FAQ, sample query logs for 100k subset (shared over S3 link in drive doc).
